source.name: Peugeot Sport – TotalEnergies partner page
source.quote: TotalEnergies has been associated with Peugeot for more than 25 years and is an official partner and technical supplier of the WEC Team Peugeot TotalEnergies project with the PEUGEOT 9X8.
source.note: Title partner: the team races in FIA WEC as 'PEUGEOT TOTALENERGIES' (fiawec.com car entry) and TotalEnergies carries the main livery branding; 'front' used for the title slot.

source.name: Peugeot Sport – Point S partner page
source.quote: Point S, official partner of Team Peugeot TotalEnergies
source.note: Partnership announced for 2025 and renewed for 2026 (peugeot-sport.com news, 19 February 2026); Point S branding on the 9X8.

source.name: Peugeot Sport – Capgemini partner page
source.quote: Capgemini, official partner of Team Peugeot TotalEnergies

source.name: Peugeot Sport – Mopar partner page
source.quote: Mopar will become a Premium Peugeot Sport partner starting in the 2026 FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC) season.

source.name: Groupe Nedey : un partenariat renouvelé avec Peugeot Sport (nedey.com)
source.quote: Cette année encore, le Groupe Nedey Automobiles compte parmi les partenaires de Peugeot Sport.
source.note: French: 'This year again, Groupe Nedey Automobiles is among Peugeot Sport's partners' (employer's own site, 30 March 2026). Nedey's logo is also in Peugeot Sport's 2026 season-reveal press kit.

source.name: Peugeot Sport – Kappa partner page
source.quote: Today, Kappa outfits the entire Peugeot TotalEnergies Team with gear that combines technical innovation and bold design.

source.name: Peugeot Sport – Sparco partner page
source.quote: Sparco – Official technical partner of Team Peugeot TotalEnergie
source.note: Supplies the 9X8's harnesses, drivers' suits/gloves/shoes and pit-crew equipment, per this page (sic 'TotalEnergie' in the page heading).

source.name: Racecar Engineering: Michelin Reveals 2026 Hypercar and GTP Tyre
source.quote: Michelin has revealed its next-generation Hypercar which will be used by all cars in the top classes of the FIA World Endurance Championship and IMSA Sportscar Championship from 2026.
source.note: Michelin is the exclusive series-wide Hypercar tyre supplier; the FIA WEC entry page for car #93 (fiawec.com/en/car/2026/93) lists 'Tyre partner: Michelin'.

summary: 2026 FIA WEC season (no standalone team kit): the Peugeot 9X8's commercial partners. TotalEnergies is the title partner (team races as Peugeot TotalEnergies); Capgemini, Mopar, Point S, Nedey, Kappa (team apparel) and Sparco (safety equipment) are the team's official partners per peugeot-sport.com's partner pages and the 2026 season-reveal press kit; Michelin is the series-wide exclusive Hypercar tyre supplier. List checked against the site's partner sitemap and the reveal press kit, which match.
